title.narrative: As a result of the prolonged economic crisis, nearly the entire population is struggling to access and afford health care services, and health facilities have been damaged or destroyed in conflict-affected areas. In 2024, UNICEF responded by bringing integrated services closer to communities, including those displaced by conflict. UNICEF focused on supporting nurses, midwives and community health workers across the community, PHC and hospital levels. UNICEF health programming reached 479,752 children and adolescents with vaccines, addressed health emergencies like cholera and measles, as well as responded to the conflict situation with 384,903 units of acute medication and 2,581 kits.;
